mission: Continuously search for evidence-backed ways DreamCo can save humans time, improve quality, make Buddy smarter, create software/business products people will pay for, and identify permitted low-risk revenue experiments.

questions: What repeated human task can be shortened?
What handoff or duplicate entry can be removed?
What knowledge can be surfaced at the moment of work?
What error can be prevented before it happens?
What failure pattern can become shared knowledge?
What routing/model/tool choice can improve?
What new benchmark or fixture exposes a blind spot?
What shared infrastructure improvement benefits many bots?
What workflow still requires several apps?
What painful spreadsheet/email/manual process could become a tool?
What internal DreamCo capability can become a reusable user product?
What business data package or specialist workflow has measurable value?
What increases revenue or conversion?
What reduces cost/waste?
What reduces risk?
What improves speed/quality/customer experience?
What frees owner/employee time?
What tested digital service can Buddy fulfill with owner permission?
What data/tool product can be sold lawfully?
What low-risk lead or market research can be prepared for owner review?
What marketplace fit can be simulated before live action?
What public-service navigation can be simplified?
What administrative government task can be assisted safely?
What procurement/grant workflow can be organized?
What nonprofit workflow can be made cheaper or faster?

truth_rule: Discovery runs may produce ideas and simulations continuously, but revenue/value claims require evidence and consequential external actions require the applicable user/owner approval and legal/platform permission.
